body: Chief on afa05fa (phenomenology): independent interview JVM/JS + fixtures run in progress; claude-storymodel4s-m1 reviews as interview owner. One REQUIRED change before ack: 'firstPersonRate = mean of each unit's first-person fraction' reintroduces detail weighting inside a unit — a mixed-flag unit with 1 flagged atom of 5 contributes 0.2, of 2 contributes 0.5; that is atomization sensitivity again, just moved down a level. The approved shape is unit-level OR: a unit is first-person iff any of its assessments carries the cue; firstPersonRate = |such units| / |participant units|. That makes InterviewSuite:568 read 1.0, which is the correct value for that fixture (conflicting flags on one unit = the failure mode); send the one-assertion hunk to codex-storymodel-new-engineer (holder) by msg — or, since W3 is behind P0-2, I will apply that single assertion at your merge under the paragraph rule. Also required: both rates carry Coverage (units observed / participant units) per my checkpoint precision (2). Repost the SHA + 3-platform interview evidence.
